cross_cutting_rules: Never say "nobody has X" where X is a family word (replay, safety checks, blocks). Say the precise thing TL uniquely has: replay ENGINE with cone recompute + divergence check; DERIVED admissibility; per-firing AUDIT; unfired-hook DISCLOSURE; region ALGEBRA. Precision is also better copy.

Three TL-side gates before the strongest claims ship: (a) the D1 replay/push crash on HF causal LMs (blocks claim-1 LLM copy and region advertising); (b) the fork.attach_hooks+run silent-unedited bug (blocks "never silently inert"); (c) the appliance replaced=False check (same).
The exact-vs-approximate frame (edge substitution vs linear attribution patching) is the durable cost story; "they must pay a full forward" is not.

Credit competitors by name for what they own (nnsight generation ergonomics + ~1x; pyvene intervention-as-artifact + trainable interventions; TLens cache kit). The concessions strengthen the switch pitch, not weaken it.

claims.version_range: as verified 2026-08-21 (nnsight feature pages; TLens official API docs; pyvene README/source)
claims.neutral_fact: No competitor has a replay ENGINE (a what-if applied to a finished recording, recomputing only the affected downstream cone, divergence-checked, audited). Two near-misses launch copy will be attacked with: TransformerLens start_at_layer/stop_at_layer are official partial-forward parameters against a cached residual stream (manual, layer-granular, no checking, no audit); nnsight tracer.stop() and Skip Execution truncate live runs. Gradient attribution patching approximates all patch variants in ~2 forwards + 1 backward.
claims.allowed_public_wording: TorchLens is the only tool with a replay engine: apply a what-if to a finished recording and recompute only the affected downstream cone -- divergence-checked and audited, never silently wrong. Everywhere else the unit of experimentation is a live forward pass: TransformerLens can hand-roll partial forwards from a cached residual stream (start_at_layer, one layer granularity, no checking), and gradient-based attribution patching trades exactness for speed; no other tool re-executes a recording.
claims.narrowed_scope_wording: While gate-d1-hf-lm-replay-crash is open: scope the sentence to recorded runs WITHOUT LLM examples, or say "live-hook reruns" for LLMs (that route works and is numerically verified).
claims.limitation_wording: TorchLens applies what-ifs to recorded runs; engine details in the intervention docs.
claims.required_credit: TransformerLens start_at_layer partial forwards; gradient attribution patching's ~2-forward cost.

claims.neutral_fact: Only pyvene treats interventions as durable objects (dict configs, IntervenableModel.save with Hub push, pyreft built on it). pyvene is NOT modelcard-locked: raw string component paths are an escape hatch -- but they are UNVERIFIED strings (no site keys, no structural verification, no drift refusal). pyvene HAS reads (CollectIntervention), site-scoped collection only. pyvene has no past tense: every intervention executes inside a live forward. nnsight model.edit() is a persistent in-memory binding, not a serializable artifact.
claims.allowed_public_wording: Only pyvene treats an intervention as a durable object -- serializable configs, trained interventions you can push to the Hub -- and we respect that. But a pyvene address is either a hand-maintained per-family alias or a bare attribute-path string; there is no structural verification and nothing that notices drift. And pyvene has no past tense: it can collect activations at a site, but there is no recording -- every question costs a live forward, and nothing is captured for audit.
claims.narrowed_scope_wording: none needed -- wording rule permanently in force (no gate).
claims.limitation_wording: Credit pyvene's artifact story without the contrast sentence.
claims.required_credit: pyvene intervention-as-artifact + trainable interventions + Hub culture.

claims.neutral_fact: Multi-site region ADDRESSING with derived admissibility: nobody has it (pyvene open P0 #226 asks for it), but single-module block edits exist elsewhere (pyvene SkipIntervention, nnsight Skip Execution, baukit edit_output). nnsight ships scan/validate (FakeTensor shape/type dry-run); TL's uniqueness is SEMANTIC admissibility derived from the captured graph -- say "derived admissibility", not "safety checks". Audit trails: no competitor produces a per-firing intervention ledger. Silent-inert detection: no competitor counts fires; TL's rerun path reconciles hook_fire_count + unfired_hook_ids. TL-side: the address algebra is REPLAY-ONLY today; live-lane regions are a design item (Build 0c).
claims.allowed_public_wording: TorchLens is the only tool where WHERE is an algebra: compose selectors over the captured graph, and admissibility is derived, not asserted -- an edit that cannot apply refuses with a remedy, in types, before your forward runs. Every firing lands in an audit you can read back; hooks that fire nowhere are counted and disclosed, not swallowed. (nnsight's scan/validate dry-runs shapes; nothing anywhere else audits what actually fired.)
claims.narrowed_scope_wording: While the two inert-detection gates are open: "we count fires and disclose unfired hooks" is true of the rerun path; never "we can never be silently inert". Keep region-SURGERY promises off live-run copy until Build 0c ships.
claims.limitation_wording: Selector composition and typed refusals described without uniqueness or inertness absolutes.

claims.version_range: as verified 2026-08-21 (nnsight Multiple Token Generation docs)
claims.neutral_fact: nnsight owns generation ergonomics (tracer.all()/iter[]/.next(), ~1x price). pyvene also intervenes during model.generate. TorchLens composes intervention with HF generation today on all three engines with byte-identical intervened tokens (edit fires at prefill + every decode step); episode capture is priced as a diagnostic: 79 s = ~103x native at N=20 (gpt2-124M, CPU, 8-token prompt), SUPERLINEAR beyond (N=100 -> 657 s = 323x). Cheapest intervened generation is record at ~42x; the ~1x capture-free tier does not exist yet.
claims.allowed_public_wording: nnsight has the best generation ergonomics in the field -- one-line tracing of model.generate with per-step intervention -- and at ~1x it owns the price point. TorchLens composes intervention with generation today (same edit, prefill and every decode step, identical tokens across all three capture engines), and adds what nobody else has: generation as a saved, replayable, audited artifact. That evidence tier is priced as a diagnostic: ~103x native at 20 steps (gpt2-124M, CPU), superlinear beyond; capture-lite runs land at ~42x today, and a capture-free runner is roadmap.
claims.narrowed_scope_wording: Any 103x citation MUST carry (CPU, gpt2-124M, N=20) and must not imply linearity in N.
claims.limitation_wording: Intervened generation composes on all three engines; costs in the benchmark table.
claims.required_credit: nnsight generation ergonomics + ~1x live price; pyvene generate-time intervention.

claims.version_range: TLens 3.x mid-pivot to TransformerBridge, as verified 2026-08-21
claims.neutral_fact: TLens owns the ActivationCache analysis kit (accumulated_resid/decompose_resid/stack_head_results/logit_attrs, FactoredMatrix/QK/OV) and ecosystem gravity (ARENA, SAELens). TLens 3.x/4.0 is mid-pivot from HookedTransformer (reimplementation, deprecated) to TransformerBridge (wrapping the REAL HF model): the "we wrap the real model, they reimplement" differentiator is TIME-LIMITED; the churn (bridge bug cluster incl. #1688 hooks that silently never fire, cite as live bug not permanent property) makes now the cheapest switching window. TLens has its own flags-before-run gates; TL's honest differentiator is typed refusal WITH A REMEDY, never "no dark hooks". TLens official zoo is 249 IDs; TLens has no input attribution; TL reads SDPA facets without eager reload (READ-ONLY -- editing still needs a visible/eager site).
claims.allowed_public_wording: If your daily driver is the ActivationCache analysis kit -- accumulated_resid, stack_head_results, direct logit attribution -- and the ARENA/SAELens ecosystem around it, TransformerLens is where that kit lives, and we say so. TorchLens is for the moment you step off the paved road: any model (not a registry), verified addresses, attribution built in, and fused-attention internals you can read without reloading the model in eager mode. TransformerLens is itself mid-migration to wrapping real HF models; if you are re-learning an API anyway, compare both.
claims.narrowed_scope_wording: none needed -- wording rule permanently in force (no gate).
claims.limitation_wording: Credit the TLens kit without the comparison sentence.
claims.required_credit: TLens ActivationCache kit + QK/OV + ARENA/SAELens gravity.
